Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api

package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api
The root of the BetterNPCs public API.

BetterNPCs is the entry point; BetterNPCsApi is the service it hands out.

Everything under dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api is covered by the compatibility promise in ApiVersion, except members annotated Internal. Nothing outside it is: the core, storage and nms packages are implementation detail and change without notice.
